PGCIL Diploma Trainee Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL) has released the exam date for the post of Diploma Trainee (Electrical)/ (Civil)/ (Survey), JOT and JTT (Survey). This recruitment was released for 668 posts. Applications for the PGCIL Diploma Trainee Recruitment 2026 were accepted from April 20, 2026, to May 11, 2026. The CBT examination is going to be conducted on 01 July 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their PGCIL Diploma Trainee Exam Date 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 20 April 2026
  • Last Date : 11 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 11 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 01 July 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • For All Other Post
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 300/-
  • SC, ST, Exs : 0/-
  • For JTT Survey Post
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST, Exs : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
